analysis_options.api: Direct RuleCollectTerms::applyOp invocation; no ActionGroup or other Rule runs
analysis_options.funcdata: Locked BfdArchitecture over the pinned Git-blob curl input supplies the Ghidra Funcdata and address spaces; each synthetic case clears prior analysis state and creates one real BlockBasic. Rugra creates an equivalent isolated Funcdata and BlockBasic per case.
analysis_options.ir: All initial ops are alive members of the synthetic block and are wired only through Funcdata op editing APIs. The shared register Varnode is an SSA input. Outputs are unique-space written Varnodes. Constants have one descendant. The observation is target-relevant structural state, not every unrelated PcodeOp/Varnode annotation.
analysis_options.normalization: Only allocation-only unique-space offsets are replaced by deterministic fixture identities. Block order, alive/dead order, operand slots, parent/order fields, Varnode storage/value/SSA class, alias identity, definitions, descendant order, return values, and all target-relevant structural mutations represented by observation_schema are preserved.
analysis_options.random_seed: none; RuleCollectTerms and fixture construction are deterministic

assets.source_policy: Materialize the four SLEIGH/spec files and curl binary from verified Git blob IDs at the pinned Rugra provenance commit; never consume their working-tree copies

binary.source_policy: Materialize the pinned provenance commit's examples/curl Git blob by verified object ID; never read the working-tree binary

observation_schema.format: Fourteen fixed-order UTF-8 records (before/after for seven cases) with a final newline
observation_schema.op_state: Target-relevant structural state: exact block/alive/dead order plus opcode, dead flag, parent block index, sequence order, ordered input identities, and output identity
observation_schema.varnode_state: Every fixture-tracked and transformation-created reachable Varnode in deterministic discovery order: space, size, semantic offset, constant/input/written/free classification, defining op, and ordered descendant op.slot list; whole-bank membership, create_index, and unrelated type/symbol/high annotations are outside this narrow observation schema
observation_schema.mutation_scope: Detached original operands remain in the tracked Varnode list, so target-operand xref removal is observable; generated constants/op/output are discovered and included. Detached nullable-slot sentinel Varnodes from the known OPBANK-0001 gap (surfaced by OP-INSERT-0001 PARTIAL_MATCH) are not projected.

OPBANK-0001.detail: Rugra PcodeOpBank cannot represent Ghidra's initially-null input slots. Funcdata::op_set_input replaces temporary sentinel Varnodes before RuleCollectTerms runs, but those detached bank-only sentinels have no Ghidra counterpart and are outside this target-relevant observation schema. This gap was surfaced and retained by OP-INSERT-0001 PARTIAL_MATCH; the fixture cannot prove whole-bank identity while OPBANK-0001 remains MISMATCH.

TYPE-UNKNOWN-0001.detail: The projection does not compare the Architecture TypeFactory-backed datatype identity/flags attached to created Varnodes.

ARCH-0001.detail: Ghidra runs the synthetic IR in a BfdArchitecture-backed Funcdata, while Rugra's synthetic Funcdata has no equivalent fully loaded Architecture/services graph. RuleCollectTerms does not read that graph on the seven projected paths.

comparand.rust_crate_tree_hash_scheme: sha256 of rugra-rule-collect-terms-lib-snapshot-v1 plus sorted length-prefixed relative paths and contents

visible_output_regression.scope: Non-authoritative end-to-end regression signal required for a ruleaction.rs change; it is not the locked 12.0.4 function oracle above.

input.materialization: git cat-file blob HEAD:examples/curl into an isolated /tmp workspace; no worktree examples/curl or result/ write

ghidra_regression_compare.golden_version_note: tests/golden/ghidra_curl.c is Ghidra 11.3.2 and remains a regression signal only until ORACLE-0002 regenerates the locked 12.0.4 golden.

visible_output_regression.differential: The broad pipeline still has two numbering issues, 258 skeleton lines, twelve timeouts, two panics, and seven syntax-failing functions. These are not explained away by the seven RuleCollectTerms projections and prevent any L3 claim.

overall_status: UNTESTED: (B2 migration of partial match state) seven target-relevant structural projections match; full-state input/output remains mismatch through OPBANK-0001 and ARCH-0001, TYPE-UNKNOWN-0001 and explicitly listed branches remain untested
